name: gemm
signature: void gemm(long ni, long nj, long nk, double alpha, double beta, double *C, const double *A, const double *B)
layout: A is an ni x nk matrix, B is an nk x nj matrix and C is an ni x nj matrix, all stored row-major: element (i, j) of a matrix with c columns is at index i*c + j. C is input and output: the function updates it starting from its initial values. No two arrays overlap. ni, nj and nk are at least 1.
